subject: Unit economics follow-up: token volumes, budget, $/1M tokens targets
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@fintechx.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: unit economics & next steps (FinTechX discovery)

Hi Sarah & Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary from call:
- Primary use: conversational agent + automated KYC assistant across web and mobile. Expect peak inference on verification flows.
- Current traffic estimate (high level): 100k unique users/month, with 3–4 verification prompts per user avg.
- Desired integration: hosted API to start, potential Dedicated in 12–18 months if throughput grows.

Open questions we flagged:
1) Target budget range for the pilot (monthly)?
2) Expected token mix: average prompt length and response length (median/95th).
3) Key unit-econ targets (e.g. target $/1M tokens, margin targets per feature, CAC payback window).

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll share a simple unit-economics workbook (token-level cost + feature mapping) for you to populate — will help us model $/1M tokens and $/feature.
- Quick follow-up call next week to walk the model and align on target pricing bands.

Deliverables: I will send the workbook (attached) and a short SOW draft for the pilot. Could you please confirm budget range and avg token lengths before our call?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments: redwood_unit_econ_model.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB) ; SOW-draft.pdf (pdf, 85KB)

From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-07-27T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: unit economics & next steps (FinTechX discovery)

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the workbook. A few answers to your questions that should help populate it: 

1) Pilot budget: we have an internal pilot budget of $30k–$50k / month for the first 3 months. If the economics are favorable we can scale.
2) Token mix (rough estimates):
   - Verification prompts: avg prompt 80 tokens / response 120 tokens (heavier generation for reasoning).
   - Account summary / chat: avg prompt 40 tokens / response 60 tokens.
   - Overall blended avg (expected for pilot): ~90 tokens per request.
   - Expected request volume during pilot: 200k–350k requests/month (spiky during business hours).
3) Unit-econ targets:
   - Target inference cost: <$5 per 1M tokens for pilot (we understand this is aggressive, but it’s our target).
   - Margin target by feature: at least 40% gross margin net of inference for core verification flows.
   - CAC payback: <6 months target — we’ll prioritize features that directly reduce manual ops cost.

We’ll try to fill the sheet and return by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Sarah
Head of Product, FinTechX
sarah.johnson@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@fintechx.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-28T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: unit economics & next steps (FinTechX discovery)

Sarah — this is perfect, thanks. I’ve attached the workbook (same file) with a baseline populated using your estimates so we can iterate quickly. A few notes on assumptions I added:

- Token pricing: I modeled three tiers (hosted standard, hosted optimized, dedicated reserved) with representative $/1M token costs. Please review the "pilot" column — I used $6/1M tokens for hosted optimized as a conservative baseline.
- Feature mapping: I split the flows into Verification (heavy), Chat/Support (medium), and Summaries (light) to produce $/feature estimates.
- CAC math: I included a simple payback calc based on ARR per customer and expected conversion lift from automation.

Can you confirm: is the $5/1M tokens target a firm cap for the pilot, or would a stretch to $6–$7/1M be acceptable if latency/quality meets your SLA? That will determine whether we recommend hosted optimized vs Dedicated baseline for the pilot.

Proposed next step: 30-minute walkthrough on Wednesday 2026-07-29 where I can go through the sheet line-by-line. Does 10:00am PT work for you?

Best,
Marissa
Attachments: redwood_unit_econ_model.xlsx (xlsx, 140KB)

From: Tom Li <tom.li@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-07-29T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: unit economics & next steps (FinTechX discovery)

Marissa — thanks for the model and for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from finance/ops side:

- Budget flexibility: $5/1M tokens is our preferred target, but we can tolerate up to $7/1M for the pilot if the model shows clear ROI and we can keep monthly spend within $50k.
- Volume confirmation: 250k requests/month is our mid-case for the pilot; we expect bursts up to ~1.2x during peak days.
- Priority features for CAC payback: verification automation (highest ROI), then dispute response automation, then agent assist. We need per-feature $/1M token and per-feature margin rows in the workbook.

If you can surface a scenario where verification flow inference cost + implementation yields >40% gross margin at $6/1M tokens, that would be ideal. If not, share what changes (quantization, batching, or a dedicated pool) get us there.

We’re good for the 10:00am PT walkthrough on 2026-07-29. Please send the calendar invite.

Tom
Head of Engineering (FinTechX)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@fintechx.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@fintechx.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: FinTechX pilot — unit econ summary + ask

Rishi / Vivek — quick internal summary after the FinTechX sync and prep for tomorrow’s walkthrough: 

Key customer asks:
- Pilot monthly budget ceiling: $50k; preferred inference target <$5/1M tokens but they can accept up to $7/1M if ROI is demonstrable.
- Pilot volume mid-case: 250k requests/month; blended ~90 tokens/request => ~22.5M tokens/month (mid-case).
- Priority: verification flow (highest ROI) — need to show per-feature margin >=40% at target pricing. CAC payback target <6 months.

Action items / asks for us:
1) Rishi — can you prepare two scenarios for the walkthrough: 
   A) Hosted optimized at $6/1M tokens with aggressive batching/kv-cache assumptions 
   B) Dedicated baseline (reserved) at effective $4.5/1M tokens after commit and quantization — include implementation timeline and infra commit risk.
2) Vivek — need guidance on promotional pricing / pilot credits (we may need to bridge to hit $5/1M target). Recommend up to $10k in pilot credits contingent on a 6-month evaluation commit.
3) I’ll update the workbook and add explicit per-feature rows (verification, dispute response, agent assist) showing $/feature, gross margin, and CAC payback assumptions.

I attached the latest workbook and the SOW draft we can iterate live tomorrow.

Marissa
Attachments: redwood_unit_econ_model.xlsx (xlsx, 165KB) ; SOW-draft.pdf (pdf, 92KB)
